content.short: Cardano City is an evolving Cardano NFT world with virtual houses, art, rarity, and exploration for collectors.
content.description: Cardano City is an evolving NFT project based on the Cardano blockchain. Its story begins with Mikka, a character who lives inside Cardano City, and expands into an immersive virtual experience where users can build, customize, trade, and explore houses and city spaces. The project includes 50,000 unique NFTs with rarity data plus premium digital paintings. Its focus is world-building, collectible ownership, and virtual activity around a Cardano-native city concept for NFT collectors and fans online.
